cashier.title: Patient billing
cashier.search_ph: Find an unpaid visit: name or phone
cashier.search_short: Type at least two letters or digits.
cashier.search_none: No unpaid visit in the last {days} days matches this search.
cashier.queue_empty: No one is waiting to pay right now. Patients appear here once they are checked in.
cashier.pick_text: Pick a visit from “Waiting to pay”, or search for any unpaid visit of the last 30 days.
cashier.already_paid: This visit has already been paid.
cashier.coverage_help: Filled in from the insurance company's coverage; it only splits the total into the patient's and the insurer's share on screen.
cashier.visit_not_found: That visit could not be found.
cashier.closings_lead: Count the cash in the drawer and compare it with the cash receipts recorded since the last closing.
cashier.closed_even: Drawer closed. The count matches the expected cash.
cashier.period_since_closing: Since the last closing on {date} at {time}
cashier.cash_expenses: Cash expenses recorded in this period ({n})
cashier.explain_since_closing: The period starts exactly where the previous closing ended, so no receipt is counted twice or missed.
cashier.explain_first: No closing yet: this first period starts with today's first cash receipt. After you close, the next period starts at that moment.
cashier.explain_cash_only: Only receipts paid in cash count. Card, transfer, insurance and wallet payments are not in the drawer. Voided invoices drop out.
cashier.explain_expenses: Expenses paid from the drawer are not deducted from the expected cash.
cashier.explain_expenses_info: Cash expenses are shown for information only; the closing records the expected cash from receipts.
cashier.close_confirm: Close the drawer now? The period ends at this moment and the count is saved.
cashier.over_help: There is more cash than expected.
cashier.short_help: There is less cash than expected.
cashier.count_helper_help: The total fills in the counted cash automatically.
cashier.notes_ph: Optional: who handed over, reasons for a difference…
cashier.slip_note: Expected cash is the total of cash receipts in this period. Expenses paid from the drawer are not deducted.

errors_cashier.CASH_SHORT: The amount received is less than the total to pay.
errors_cashier.DRAWER_CHANGED: New cash receipts were recorded while you were counting. The figures below are up to date: check the count and close again.
errors_cashier.VISIT_NOT_DONE: {name} is still waiting or with the doctor — they pay once the doctor is done, so no second invoice is issued.
